levels.description: Gains SP when Infected Creatures are defeated, if said Creatures are defeated within its Attack Range, gains doubled SP; when skill is activated, grants a small amount of <@ba.drop>Training Handbooks</> and <@ba.drop>Strategic Beacons</>, while generating several <@ba.enemy>Originium Slugs β</> on surrounding tiles (grants a minimal amount of <@ba.drop>Training Handbooks</> when defeated)
